reviews.classification: dated source-screening/proposal record; scoped implementation and later-owner qualifications
reviews.disposition: Initial F1–F3/C1–C11 screening is dated public source/developer evidence, not current releases or ordinary-play verification. CATA testing unlocks, XP and empty cultivation files established a UI prototype at its pinned revision; realm/map tab labels did not establish gameplay. Neko/GauTech fork:false explains why fork-network-only discovery missed derivatives without proving an exhaustive ecosystem. GauTech and original Progress Knight already had dossiers; Neko was user-supplied, not unknown to the user. Developer claims about sect history, family autonomy and many progression layers remain claims until actual consumers are traced. The later four-project report provides selected code/probe evidence beyond screening, but its captured-file counts do not equal full-source reading or save/native proof. Its opening one-realm/prestige milestone wording is superseded by the October24 scope direction; preserve distinct-world institutional continuity, process properties, meaningful advancement and earned-history candidates without making that retired milestone a gate. Search absence is bounded to searched public Markdown, not every private/chat source. Old recommendations, licenses and download/platform availability require fresh verification only for selected follow-up; no new research or adoption is launched.

reviews.classification: dated source-screening/proposal record; scoped implementation and later-owner qualifications
reviews.disposition: The Xeus24 report records a pinned source/notes audit split across readers; the mod was never played and its measurements are attributed to its author. Titles, Renown, star crafting, cultivation, save slots and catch-up are distinct source ideas, not universal YAIR rules. F3's keyed title object prevents that particular positional-list doubling mechanism, not every duplicate grant or stacked-bonus bug. O1 records a historical26-title implementation, derived replacement bonuses, unknown-ID retention and explicit old-empty compatibility; six focused and279 whole-suite checks bind that older input only. The actual first kill, defeat and reload trials differ from a synthetic120-kill backfill; final import after wiping test storage is not fresh earned long-horizon coverage. XP multiplier precedence repair changes other formerly dormant bonuses and pacing, beyond title tuning. Rank/worn/passive Renown, live-gate readiness, generated codex, optional catch-up and backup rotation remain candidates; source-specific pill bottlenecks and max-HP tribulation are dials, not global laws. Human feel is optional review under AD42; old narrow-screen backlog is not a new mobile gate. No runtime, counts or upstream PR status reverified here.

reviews.classification: dated source-screening/proposal record; scoped implementation and later-owner qualifications
reviews.disposition: The preset fit is a catalogue of prompt ideas, not controlled model quality or autonomous coding proof. Pura compact core, distilled Vivarium and selected Voyage prose need translation from frontend macros/order; a JSON module need not be enabled. Community size/compatibility claims and documented8192/2048 launcher limits are dated, not current installed profiles. Closed runtime facts, actor knowledge, player agency, RNG, trades, injuries and elapsed time remain game-owned; offline inventions are labelled proposals. A prompt summary is not durable memory. P1–P5 are newly written task templates, not quoted/tested coding presets, and plain ollama run had no filesystem or shell tools in the inspected launcher. Proposed diffs/checks cannot claim applied edits or executed tests. Preserve concrete reproduction, strongest alternative, bounded counterexample and open-invention boundary. A1/A2 trials remain unrun, and jailbreak/uncensored labels or longer reasoning do not establish better voice, continuity or correctness. Existing P15/T5 owners retain validation/fallback/frozen-text/persistence authority; no model/default/install or runtime route is selected.
